reply_text:
I replied to Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the 2026 renewal is at 185 seats according to the signed paperwork. Ilse's 261 hasn't been confirmed.

- **Why 185:** The 2026 Renewal Order Form (signed 2026-03-20, effective 2026-04-01) only changed price and the term end date. So the seat count still comes from Amendment No. 1: 185 seats, effective 2025-09-01. The current term runs to 2027-03-31.
- **Coming change:** Amendment No. 3 (signed 2026-09-22) raises it to 230 seats from 2027-01-01. The account page shows the same figures: 185 now, 230 from January.
- **The 261 problem:** On Oct 14 Ilse posted 261 seats for this renewal, and I acknowledged it without checking. I can't find 261 in any contract or amendment. I told Dana not to put it in the tracker yet and asked Ilse, in the same thread, where it came from.

I left the per-seat price and discount out of my reply, because those are finance figures under the admin rules and nobody had posted them in that channel.
